extracted.intended_audience: article peer reviewers (students, researchers, clinicians) seeking guidance and training
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for conducting peer review of journal manuscripts, covering stages from deciding to accept a review through reading, reporting, ethics, and training. Aggregates publisher checklists, example reviews, and courses for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Before you Accept an Invitation to Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations and criteria to apply before accepting a request to review a manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Reading of the Manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to approach the initial read-through of a submitted manuscript to form an overall impression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed Reading of the Manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and focus areas for a careful, line-by-line or section-by-section evaluation of the manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structuring your Peer Review Report
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice on how to organize and present reviewer comments and recommendations to the editor and authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical Guidelines for Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and ethical considerations reviewers must follow (conflicts of interest, confidentiality, professionalism).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cambridge University Press Guide to Peer Reviewing Journal Articles
rubrics_metrics.description: Publisher guide to peer reviewing journal articles (external resource linked).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link to Cambridge University Press guidance for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elsevier Peer Review Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Elsevier's checklist to help reviewers evaluate submissions (external resource linked).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a structured checklist format to assess manuscripts; linked from the guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Example of a Published Peer Review Report
rubrics_metrics.description: An example (published) peer review report to illustrate tone, structure, and level of detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete example intended to show how a completed review might look.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sage Journals Peer Reviewer's Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: SAGE publisher guidance for peer reviewers (external resource linked).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link to SAGE's reviewer guidance and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taylor & Francis Peer Review Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Taylor & Francis checklist for reviewers, including resources for both research and non-research articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes checklists for research and non-research articles (explicitly noted on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Wiley Step by Step Guide to Reviewing a Manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: A step-by-step walkthrough from Wiley on how to review a manuscript (external resource linked).

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Training Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities and courses for reviewers to build skills and confidence in peer reviewing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certified Peer Reviewer Course (Elsevier Researcher Academy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Elsevier Researcher Academy's Certified Peer Reviewer course designed to give skills and confidence to accept peer review requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free access upon registration; aimed at training reviewers in best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nature MasterClass: Focus on Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Nature's MasterClass course focused on peer review for students and researchers new to peer review or wishing to refresh skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted at newcomers and those refreshing skills; free to access upon registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wiley Peer Review Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Wiley's reviewer resources and training materials, including an introductory 3-part video series on basics of peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a 3-part introductory video series; free resources for new reviewers.
